artifacts.notes: One page image of leaf n231 of item gregoriansacrame00cath, which is Wilson 1915 printed p. 174 (running head 'DOM. XVII. POST PENTECOSTEN.'). One page only, not the volume: a negative read off it is an absence from this page and from nothing wider. POST PENTECOSTEN., all three composed orations of the 1962 Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost, and the Secret here reads 'contra diabolicos tueantur semper incursus' where the 1962 book reads 'contra diabolicos semper tueantur incursus'. work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The papal sacramentary sent by Hadrian I to Charlemagne, transmitted with the supplement long ascribed to Alcuin. It is the immediate ancestor of the medieval and Tridentine Roman Mass books and the second great reservoir the twentieth-century reform drew its orations from.
work.title: Sacramentarium Gregorianum (Hadrianum)
